old: A real person, near you, free. County Veterans Service Officers (CVSOs) and accredited VSO reps file claims, gather evidence, and represent you \u2014 at no cost, ever. These official locators are maintained by the VA and NACVSO and stay current:
new: County or tribal veterans offices can help with benefits questions. For VA claims representation, check the individual in VA's accreditation search. Accredited VSO representatives provide claims help free of charge; accredited attorneys and claims agents may charge permitted fees. Contact the representative to confirm availability.
